cohort: 155 pregnant women at term with a Bishop score of 6 or less requiring labor induction.
finding: Double-balloon catheter and dinoprostone vaginal insert showed similar vaginal delivery and cesarean section rates, as well as similar neonatal outcomes, although the double-balloon catheter group required more oxytocin but experienced less uterine hyperstimulation.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates did not differ between the two induction methods.
